prOriginal.nota: Found via commit history of server-spi-private/.../CredentialHelper.java: squash commit 134437a5 'Create recovery keys in user storage or local (#38446)'. PR head sha equals benchmark head ce2dcc53; the squash tree is identical to the benchmark head for all 8 touched files.

implement-recovery-key-support-for-user-.reason: BackwardsCompatibilityUserStorage.getCredentials on main still builds the recovery-codes credential with RecoveryAuthnCodesCredentialModel.createFromValues(codes, createdDate, userLabel) and never copies myUser.recoveryCodes.getId(); createFromValues still sets no id. The only later commit on the file is the Spotless import reorder (#43432).

CredentialHelper.createRecoveryCodesCredential on main still returns right after user.credentialManager().updateCredential(...) succeeds in the user storage, without calling the local provider's createCredential (the only change, #50787 on 2026-10-07, adds a return value). UserCredentialManager.isValid still runs the local CredentialInputValidators for inputs the storage did not validate, so an older local recovery-codes credential is neither removed nor stops validating.

RecoveryAuthnCodesFormAuthenticator on main still takes the credential from RecoveryAuthnCodesUtils.getCredential (federated first) and, when allCodesUsed(), removes it with credentialManager().removeStoredCredentialById(id), which goes to getStoreForUser (local store) only. Later commits (#38994, #39213, #40021, #42050) touched other parts of the authenticator, not this removal.

RecoveryAuthnCodesUtils.getCredential on main is unchanged: getFederatedCredentialsStream() is queried first, then local storage. UserCredentialManager.getFederatedCredentialsStream still delegates straight to the provider's getCredentials, and LDAPStorageProvider.getCredentials still loads the LDAP object and throws IllegalStateException when it is missing.
